results.fact: Approach time to the tower base
results.evidence: The only documented Mushroom Tower trip (June 2010) gives an 8-hour round trip including Big Kangaroo but no time to the base. The Big Kangaroo west-route description gives 5-6 hours from the cars (to its summit), which does not isolate this approach. No two sources state a car-to-base time for Mushroom Tower; a timed ascent of the hairpin-to-Mushroom gully would settle whether 1.5-2.5 h or 2.5-4 h is right.

results.correct_value: Closes roughly late November or early December; reopens in April or early May (snow-dependent)

The historical opening/closing record (from the state DOT's table) gives a typical opening around April 23 and closing around November 24, with recent closures on Nov 30 2023 and Dec 4 2025. The row's three fields disagreed; all copies are aligned to that window.

results.fact: Time from car to Kangaroo Pass
results.correct_value: About 1 to 1.5 hours car to Kangaroo Pass
results.evidence: A 2022 trip report timed the hairpin to Kangaroo Pass at about 1:15 for ~1.5 miles, then another 1:15 to the summit. A separate Kangaroo Temple account notes the pass was reached one hour from the car despite the 2-hour guidebook estimate. The approach text and waypoint already say 1-1.5 h; the 'roughly 2 hours' line and the 2-3 h partner figures are aligned. The itinerary's +1.5-2 hr planning step overlaps and is left alone.
